preconditions.description: There is at least one test case.
The number of rows and columns in the matrix is between 4 and 64, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N^2 over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of elements in the matrix does not exceed 3 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: The output is an integer representing the minimum number of operations required to sort the matrix.
postconditions.description: The output must be the smallest number of transpositions needed to sort the matrix in row-major order.
